name: OKEGAS
description: Chrome extension that brings AI-powered app building to Google Apps Script editor. Features multi-model AI, code generation, code review, live preview, templates, and publishing tools for rapid GAS development.
community_quotes: AI App Builder that codes inside Google Apps Script for you

name: Thunderbolt
description: Mozilla's open-source, cross-platform AI client focused on self-hosted infrastructure and enterprise control. Eliminates vendor lock-in by allowing organizations to choose their models and own their data. Supports Claude Code Skills integration with slash commands.
community_quotes: AI You Control: Choose your models. Own your data. Eliminate vendor lock-in.
Mozilla's open-source AI client for self-hosted infrastructure

name: FlutterAIDev
description: AI-powered Flutter app generator that creates clean Flutter code with real preview from app ideas. Allows exporting APK and source code for rapid testing and iteration. Generates production-ready mobile apps from text descriptions.
community_quotes: Describe your app idea and FlutterAIDev generates clean Flutter code with a real preview

name: Ovren
description: AI-powered engineering department that provides autonomous AI frontend and backend developers to understand codebases and execute real tasks. Delivers production-ready code updates with one-click GitHub integration and review-before-merge workflow.
community_quotes: Your AI engineering department that ships your backlog

name: GitHub Stacked PRs
description: Tool that breaks big changes into small reviewable PRs - an AI-powered workflow tool for code review automation that helps manage large code changes through intelligent decomposition.
community_quotes: Break big changes into small reviewable PRs

name: shutup-mcp
description: Zero-config MCP proxy that hides 99% of tools from AI agents until needed, achieving 98% token reduction and 85% faster response times. Sits between agents and MCP servers, intelligently showing only 3-5 relevant tools instead of all available tools.
community_quotes: Zero-config MCP proxy that hides 99% of tools
